subject: Tagging inventory & lawful-basis mapping for DPA onboarding
messages:
From: Elaine Summers <elaine.summers@brightretail.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: privacy@brightretail.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Tagging inventory & lawful-basis mapping for DPA onboarding

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of BrightRetail's data processing assessment for our DPA onboarding, our privacy team needs a short packet that documents the website tagging inventory and the lawful basis for any data the tags transmit (consent vs legitimate interest). In particular we need:

- A CSV of all active tags (name, vendor, purpose, destination domains, GTM container ID if applicable)
- A short note for each tag describing whether it ever sends PII or identifiers (email, user ids, device ids) and if so how those are handled (hashed/ pseudonymised, encrypted, server-side).
- Cookie banner behavior: which cookies fire before consent, which require consent, and a screenshot of the banner in desktop & mobile.
- Sample consent logs (anonymised strings are fine) showing timestamp, consent string, and whether consent was collected or declined.
- Any server-side forwarding or pixel proxies in use (e.g., conversion forwarding to ad networks).

We have a one-week window to review before Legal signs the DPA. Can you provide a preliminary packet within 48 hours and a full evidence set within 5 business days? I attached our intake form for reference.

If you prefer a short call to walk through the ask, I'm available Mon/Tue next week.

Best,
Elaine Summers
Privacy & Compliance Manager
BrightRetail

Attachment: brightretail-request-form.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Tagging inventory & lawful-basis mapping for DPA onboarding

Thanks Elaine — got the intake form and the list of asks. We'll take this on.

Plan:
- I'll deliver an initial tag inventory CSV and cookie-banner screenshots within 48 hours (shared link + attachments).
- Karthik will add a technical note describing whether tags send identifiers and any server-side forwarding.
- Mina will run a quick cookie-scan and produce a short PDF report.
- Neha will pull a small, anonymised consent-log sample.

Question for BrightRetail: do you need per-country lawful-basis mapping (e.g., UK vs EU differences) or is a single EU-focused mapping fine for now?

We'll mark anything that could be considered marketing/advertising so Legal can focus. If you want the call, I'm free Mon 10:00-11:00ET.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial_tag_inventory_draft.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Summers <elaine.summers@brightretail.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Tagging inventory & lawful-basis mapping for DPA onboarding

Hi Elaine — adding the technical context requested. Short summary below; full notes in the tag inventory CSV and linked drive folder.

- GTM: container ID GTM-PL8KX7. We manage tags via a central GTM container.
- Analytics: Google Analytics (ga4) configured with IP anonymisation. GA does not capture raw IP addresses; user_pseudo_id is used for session stitching.
- Marketing pixels: Facebook/Meta and LinkedIn pixels are only triggered after cookie-consent for marketing category. Conversion events for ad networks are proxied server-side for a small subset (order confirmations); in those cases we only forward order_id hashed server-side, no raw customer email.
- A/B testing: third-party vendor 'Variantly' sets an assignment cookie that is first-party and does not transmit email addresses.
- Third-party tag exceptions: one legacy tag (partner-ads.example.com) fires on page load for historical reasons; we're flagging it for removal.

Attached is a short screenshot showing a sampling of network calls and the GTM preview panel. We'll mark columns in the inventory for: sends_identifier (yes/no), identifier_type, forwarding_mode (client/server/none).

Karthik Iyer
Staff SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: tagging-sample-logs.png

From: Elaine Summers <elaine.summers@brightretail.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: privacy@brightretail.com, dpia@consultancy.io
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 12:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Tagging inventory & lawful-basis mapping for DPA onboarding

Thanks both — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications before Legal reviews:

1) We will need a sample consent log showing the consent string, a timestamp, and whether the user accepted marketing cookies. Anonymised values (hashed or tokenised) are fine — we only need to validate that consent is captured and stored.
2) Please confirm whether any cookies are set before consent is obtained (besides strictly necessary cookies). Our scanner flagged a set-cookie event on fusion-banner.example.com during an unauthenticated crawl; if that cookie is marketing-related we need it removed or gated.

A short call would still be useful to walk the Legal reviewer through the server-side forwarding you mentioned (we might need the hashed order_id handling described in a one-line technical note). Can you do Tue 14:00-14:30 CEST / Tue 08:00-08:30 ET?

Also: if you can upload the sample consent logs and the cookie-scan report to the Drive folder in your reply, we'll share them with our DPA reviewer.

Best,
Elaine

On a related note, dpia@consultancy.io asked whether you have an internal DPIA reference or precedent for e-commerce telemetry; they said a 2-page note would be ideal.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Summers <elaine.summers@brightretail.com>, privacy@brightretail.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 15:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Tagging inventory & lawful-basis mapping for DPA onboarding

Hi Elaine — thanks for the quick review. Per your asks, we've uploaded the following to the shared folder and attached samples to this thread:

- tag_inventory_v1.csv (full inventory with columns: tag_name, vendor, purpose, destination_domains, sends_identifier, identifier_type, forwarding_mode, notes)
- cookie-scan-report.pdf (summary of cookies observed; flagged any cookie that fires pre-consent)
- consent-log-sample.csv (3 anonymised rows: consent_string, timestamp_utc, marketing_consent=true/false)
- tagging-sample-logs.png (GTM preview and network call snapshot)

Quick answers inline:
- Per-country mapping: we can provide a single EU-focused mapping now; if you need UK-specific notes we can add them in the next delivery.
- Cookies before consent: our scan shows only strictly-necessary cookies firing pre-consent. The fusion-banner.example.com cookie you saw is a first-party session cookie for the consent banner itself (no marketing payload). We've flagged the legacy partner tag for removal and will include that remediation timeline in the follow-up.
- Server-side forwarding: confirmed — order confirmations forward a hashed order_id to ad networks; no raw email or PII is forwarded. We'll add a one-line technical note that describes the hashing algorithm and retention window.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBRIGHTRETAIL-evidence (access set to anyone with the link; let us know if you'd prefer a restricted share).

Next steps: If Legal wants more depth on any tag, tell us which rows to expand and we'll prioritize. We can do the Tue call at 08:00 ET / 14:00 CEST — calendar invite to follow.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tag_inventory_v1.csv, cookie-scan-report.pdf, consent-log-sample.csv, tagging-sample-logs.png
